title: Home page hero variants
description: data/hero.json: the headline and subhead variants of the blowhorn.ai home page hero. The default variant is rendered into the static HTML (no-JS visitors, crawlers, social previews); assets/js/hero.js may swap in another at page load. See docs/hero-variants.md.

default.description: Id of the variant rendered into the static HTML. Must be one of variants[].id (the build fails otherwise).

variants.description: Every variant, in rotation order: the daily rule picks variants[day % length].

id.description: URL-safe id, used in ?hero=<id> and data-hero-variant.

headline.description: The h1. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

subhead.description: The paragraph under the h1. Plain text, hyphens never em dashes.

differentiators.description: Numbers of the claims this copy rests on in Blowhorn's canonical differentiators list. Copy may only state what those claims allow.

note.description: Why this variant exists, for reviewers. Not rendered.
